$comment: Furniture models for the viewer. `pnpm --filter web normalize-furniture` reads each source from assets/furniture/source/, scales it to real-world metres (by `scale`, or uniformly to `height_m`), turns its long side along X (plus `yaw_degrees`), stands it on the floor centred on the origin, and writes apps/web/public/models/furniture/<id>.glb plus an index.json the viewer reads. `label` uses the detector's labels (sofa, chair, table, desk, bed, storage, counter): scanned furniture is drawn as a model with its label, the closest in size. Sources are never modified, so rerunning is safe.
